title: Permea Split Policy
description: How a benchmark's data is partitioned. Identity-controlled splitting is the DEFAULT. Random splitting is permitted but must be explicitly declared and justified, and triggers PERMEA-W001.

method.description: Partitioning method. Default and recommended: identity_controlled_grouped_kfold.

leakage_assertions.description: Machine-checked POSTconditions. Evaluated after splits are materialised. A violation fails the run; it is not a warning.

origin.description: Where the predefined split came from. 'inherited_from_prior_work' is the common case and is worth knowing: an inherited split inherits its leakage.

allOf.$comment: ENFORCEMENT 1 — identity control is the default. Disabling it REQUIRES a written declaration. Emits PERMEA-W001.
ENFORCEMENT 2 — an identity-controlled method must actually carry an identity_control block.
ENFORCEMENT 3 — stratified_kfold is by definition not identity-controlled, so it must declare.
ENFORCEMENT 4 — a predefined split must say where it came from.

enabled.description: DEFAULT TRUE. When false, random_split_declaration is required and PERMEA-W001 is emitted.

min_clusters.description: Guard against degenerate clustering. If the realised cluster count falls below this, the run emits PERMEA-W501 (cluster-bootstrap CIs are not trustworthy at low cluster counts).

tool.$comment: pairwise_align is the default because it is pure-Python and installs with `pip install permea`. mmseqs2 is the performance option but is a bioconda burden; requiring it would cost us adoption. NOTE: the two do NOT agree at the same nominal threshold — see README non-claims.

identity_threshold.description: Sequences at or above this identity are placed in the same cluster and therefore may never span folds.

identity_definition.$comment: THE FIELD NOBODY DECLARES. 'identity >= 0.4' is not a specification. The denominator and the gap treatment change which sequences cluster together, and therefore change the headline number. Required, no default -- we force an explicit choice.

denominator.description: What the match count is divided by. Permea's own convention (per the Paper 1 harness) is shorter_sequence.

gap_treatment.description: free = gaps do not reduce identity; penalized = gaps count against it.

random_split_declaration.$comment: Required whenever identity control is off. Presence of this block ALWAYS emits PERMEA-W001. It is an honest escape hatch, not a loophole: the benchmark still runs, but every artifact it produces is stamped identity_controlled=false and it cannot reach conformance level L2.

justification.description: A written, human reason. Minimum length is deliberate: it must cost something to declare.
